- hsm_attestation_redacted_20261007.pdf (vendor-signed attestation; redacted per request)

Summary (high level):
- HSM vendor & model: Thales Luna HSM series (clustered deployment). Attestation covers tamper-evidence, firmware version, and vendor serial ranges (see PDF).
- Rotation cadence: Customer KEKs are rotated on a 90-day schedule by default; tenant wrapping keys rotated automatically on successful upstream KEK rotation or on-demand for emergency rotations.
- Automation: Rotations are orchestrated by our key-management pipeline; rotation events are recorded in the rotation log and trigger verification jobs that confirm successful KV cache invalidation and replay tests.
- BYOK flow: Customer generates key locally -> key wrapped using vendor KEK -> wrapped material uploaded to Redwood storage (encrypted at transit and at rest). We store only wrapped key blobs; we never persist unwrapped customer private key material.
- Access controls: Role-based privileges (ops_oncall: rotate, sec_ops: approveRotation, platform_admin: wrap/unwrap for emergency only). Last access review: 2026-09-30 (included in the matrix).
